Does TLS 1.3 still support RSA key exchange the way TLS 1.2 did?<|eot_id|><|start_header_id|>assistant<|end_header_id|>

No. RFC 8446 section 1.3 ('Major Differences from TLS 1.2') states: 'Static RSA and Diffie-Hellman cipher suites have been removed; all public-key based key exchange mechanisms now provide forward secrecy.' TLS 1.3 negotiates only (EC)DHE key exchange or PSK-based modes (RFC 8446 sections 4.1.1, 4.2.7). RSA certificates remain valid for use in CertificateVerify signatures, but RSA key transport is gone. Cite: RFC 8446 sections 1.3, 4.2.7.<|eot_id|>
